title: Technical Product Manager Advancement Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to deepen technical product expertise, build a compelling portfolio, and prepare for senior roles. Focuses on core product skills, real‑world deliverables, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build the technical base needed to communicate effectively with engineering teams.

milestones.title: API Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can explain API architectures, authentication, and versioning to stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read API design guide
tasks.description: Study the RESTful API design guide on MDN to understand resources, methods, and status codes.

tasks.title: Create a sample endpoint
tasks.description: Use Node.js and Express to build a simple GET endpoint that returns JSON data.

tasks.title: Test with Postman
tasks.description: Send requests to the endpoint, verify responses, and document findings.

tasks.title: Summarize key concepts
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary of API versioning strategies and error handling.

milestones.title: Technical Specification Basics
milestones.outcome: Can draft clear, concise technical specs for product features.

tasks.title: Study spec template
tasks.description: Review the Google API design guide spec template on GitHub.

tasks.title: Write spec for a login flow
tasks.description: Draft a technical spec covering request/response, validation, and error cases.

tasks.title: Peer review draft
tasks.description: Exchange specs with a colleague and incorporate feedback.

tasks.title: Create checklist
tasks.description: Develop a reusable checklist for future specs to ensure completeness.

tasks.title: Reflect on clarity
tasks.description: Assess how understandable the spec is to a non‑engineer audience.

milestones.title: SQL Essentials
milestones.outcome: Can query databases to extract product usage metrics.

tasks.title: Complete SQL basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the introductory SQL module covering SELECT, WHERE, and JOIN.

tasks.title: Write usage query
tasks.description: Craft a query that returns daily active users per feature from a sample schema.

tasks.title: Visualize results
tasks.description: Export query results to CSV and create a simple chart in Google Sheets.

tasks.title: Document query logic
tasks.description: Write brief comments explaining each part of the query for future reference.

tasks.title: Reflect on data gaps
tasks.description: Identify missing data points that would improve product decisions.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop product management capabilities that drive delivery and stakeholder alignment.

milestones.title: Prioritisation Frameworks
milestones.outcome: Can apply systematic methods to rank features and initiatives.

tasks.title: Read RICE scoring article
tasks.description: Study the RICE framework article on Intercom to understand scoring components.

tasks.title: Score three backlog items
tasks.description: Apply RICE to three real items, calculate scores, and rank them.

tasks.title: Facilitate prioritisation workshop
tasks.description: Run a 30‑minute session with a cross‑functional team using the scores.

tasks.title: Gather feedback
tasks.description: Collect participant input on the process and note improvements.

tasks.title: Connect with senior PM
tasks.description: Schedule a 15‑minute chat to discuss prioritisation challenges.

milestones.title: Delivery Planning
milestones.outcome: Can create realistic roadmaps and release plans aligned with engineering capacity.

tasks.title: Study agile roadmap guide
tasks.description: Read the Atlassian roadmap best practices article.

tasks.title: Map a quarterly roadmap
tasks.description: Draft a roadmap for a hypothetical platform using a Gantt view.

tasks.title: Estimate effort with story points
tasks.description: Break roadmap items into user stories and assign points with a team mock‑session.

tasks.title: Identify dependencies
tasks.description: Create a dependency matrix for the roadmap items.

tasks.title: Reflect on feasibility
tasks.description: Assess whether the timeline matches typical velocity data.

milestones.title: Developer Empathy
milestones.outcome: Can anticipate engineering concerns and foster collaborative relationships.

tasks.title: Read developer experience article
tasks.description: Read the Stripe blog post on engineering empathy.

tasks.title: Interview a developer
tasks.description: Conduct a 20‑minute interview to learn pain points in spec hand‑off.

tasks.title: Create empathy map
tasks.description: Summarize findings in an empathy map highlighting needs and frustrations.

tasks.title: Adjust spec template
tasks.description: Incorporate developer feedback into the technical spec checklist.

tasks.title: Reflect on communication
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how empathy improved spec clarity.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Assemble portfolio pieces that demonstrate end‑to‑end product thinking.

milestones.title: API Product Spec Project
milestones.outcome: A polished API spec ready for stakeholder review.

tasks.title: Select an API idea
tasks.description: Choose a realistic API product relevant to your industry.

tasks.title: Research market needs
tasks.description: Gather three competitor examples and note gaps.

tasks.title: Write full spec
tasks.description: Produce a comprehensive spec covering endpoints, auth, rate limits, and error codes.

tasks.title: Create visual diagram
tasks.description: Draw an architecture diagram using draw.io to accompany the spec.

tasks.title: Collect peer feedback
tasks.description: Share the spec with two engineers and iterate based on comments.

tasks.title: Publish on portfolio site
tasks.description: Upload the final spec and diagram to your personal website.

milestones.title: Technical Roadmap Project
milestones.outcome: A strategic roadmap showing phased platform evolution.

tasks.title: Define platform vision
tasks.description: Write a concise vision statement for the platform’s future.

tasks.title: Identify milestones
tasks.description: Outline three major releases with key capabilities.

tasks.title: Estimate timelines
tasks.description: Assign rough dates and resources to each milestone.

tasks.title: Add risk assessment
tasks.description: List top three risks per milestone and mitigation plans.

tasks.title: Prepare presentation deck
tasks.description: Create slides summarizing the roadmap for executives.

tasks.title: Rehearse stakeholder pitch
tasks.description: Practice delivering the deck to a colleague and refine.

milestones.title: Data‑Backed Feature Proposal
milestones.outcome: A proposal that uses analytics to justify a new feature.

tasks.title: Select a feature idea
tasks.description: Pick a feature that could improve user retention.

tasks.title: Gather usage data
tasks.description: Query a sample dataset (Kaggle) to extract relevant metrics.

tasks.title: Analyze impact
tasks.description: Use simple statistical tests to estimate potential uplift.

tasks.title: Write proposal document
tasks.description: Combine data insights with user stories into a formal proposal.

tasks.title: Create supporting charts
tasks.description: Design three clear charts in Google Sheets to illustrate findings.

tasks.title: Seek stakeholder review
tasks.description: Present the proposal to a mock product council and note feedback.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish expertise, showcase leadership, and prepare for senior‑level interviews.

milestones.title: Advanced API Strategies
milestones.outcome: Can design versioning, throttling, and monetization models for large APIs.

tasks.title: Study GraphQL vs REST article
tasks.description: Read the GraphQL vs REST comparison on the official GraphQL site.

tasks.title: Design versioning plan
tasks.description: Create a versioning strategy document for your API project.

tasks.title: Prototype throttling logic
tasks.description: Implement a simple rate‑limit middleware in Node.js.

tasks.title: Connect with API product lead
tasks.description: Arrange a 20‑minute conversation to discuss scaling challenges.

tasks.title: Reflect on trade‑offs
tasks.description: Write a short note comparing the pros and cons of each approach.

milestones.title: Leadership & Influence
milestones.outcome: Can lead cross‑functional initiatives and mentor junior PMs.

tasks.title: Read servant leadership article
tasks.description: Read the Harvard Business Review piece on servant leadership.

tasks.title: Facilitate a cross‑team sync
tasks.description: Run a 45‑minute alignment meeting for a mock feature launch.

tasks.title: Mentor a junior PM
tasks.description: Provide feedback on a junior’s spec draft and prioritisation exercise.

tasks.title: Gather 360 feedback
tasks.description: Ask peers for feedback on your facilitation style.

tasks.title: Connect with senior PM community
tasks.description: Join a free online product manager meetup and introduce yourself.

milestones.title: Senior Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Ready to articulate experience and solve case studies in senior TPM interviews.

tasks.title: Review common interview questions
tasks.description: Read the list of senior product manager interview questions on Glassdoor.

tasks.title: Craft STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three STAR stories highlighting prioritisation challenges you solved.

tasks.title: Practice case study
tasks.description: Do a timed product case on API monetization and record your answer.

tasks.title: Get mock interview feedback
tasks.description: Schedule a 45‑minute mock interview with a peer and note suggestions.

tasks.title: Reflect on gaps
tasks.description: Identify two areas to improve before real interviews and plan actions.
